16.7% (Trio) |music-1 = '''Wave 1-9''' [[File:(Official) Tower Defense Simulator OST - Harvesting Season Theme|center|250px|thumb]] |music-2 = '''Wave 10-19 (Bugged)''' [[File:(Official) Tower Defense Simulator OST - They Are Coming...|center|250px|thumb]] |music-3 = '''Final Wave (Bugged, [[Jack-o-Bot]])''' [[File:(Official) Tower Defense Simulator OST - Reignited (Jack O Bot's Theme)|center|250px|thumb]]}} __TOC__ ==Description== '''The Haunted Past''' was the event [[Maps|map]] for the second act of the [[Lunar Overture Event]]. Like other event maps, this map had a specialized wave structure with special enemies. Players started with a varying amount of cash, based on how many players there were in the match. In solo it was {{Money|1,200}}, in duo it was {{Money|1,100}} and in trio it was {{Money|900}}. If you were in the Paradoxum Games group, it was increased by {{Money|100}}. This map had the [[HP Locked]] modifier, which sets the base health to 100. It also had [[Mutation]] which increased the enemy health by 10% of their regular health. Both these modifiers increased rewards by 20%, which is a total increase of 40%. This map had a unique system of giving players cash for killing or damaging enemies. You only got cash from them if they were killed, or in some cases, damaged by a specific amount of health. Additionally, the amount you got was a set amount of cash, which was not always equal to the enemy's health. In solo, you received 100% of the cash when an enemy is killed or you damaged it enough. With each additional player, this decreased by 25%, which means that in a trio, you only got 50% of the cash. This amount was distributed between players based on how much damage they dealt. However, if a player did not deal any damage, they would receive a percentage of the enemy's full cash upon its death or when it was damaged enough, which was 12.5% in duo and 16.7% in trio. If it was a decimal, it was rounded up. For example, the [[Scarecrow (Lunar Overture)|Scarecrow]] gave {{Money|100}} when killed in solo, {{Money|75}} in duo and {{Money|50}} in trio between the players that damaged it. Players that did not damage it received {{Money|12.5}} in duo, which was rounded up to {{Money|13}} and {{Money|16.7}} in trio, which was rounded up to {{Money|17}}. ==Design and Path== For both stages, the map was set in a large purple and yellow colored theater. Multiple lights and chandeliers could be seen on the walls or on the ceiling. It had multiple seats that were empty. The actual map took place in the middle of the theater, being separated from the audience by a large gap, with only small ropes with lines connecting them. ===Stage One=== The first stage was similar to [[Nightmare Carnival]]. The path started from a cave, immediately going down into a broken down stone gate-arch, which immediately crossed over onto a wood footbridge over a bright green lake. The path proceeded onto a stone walkway, making several short turns roughly in a circle, intersecting various lampposts and carnival tents. The path again crossed over the lake, approximating another wide circle, intersecting various lampposts, trees and tents. A tall orange tower could be found at the back of the map. Various dead trees, pumpkins, carnival banners and hills could have been found scattered over the map. ===Stage Two=== The second stage was similar to [[Trick or Threat Town]]. In the center of the map was a large hill with a statue in the center of it which provided valuable cliff space. The path began at a similar broken down stone gate-arch. The path had changed, with a small turn beginning the path before immediately doubling back to a longer stretch, circling around the center statue and another hill before making a few final turns to the exit. Various lampposts could be found around corners, with fallen trees and rocks decorating the landscape. A large cottage was found near the rear half of the map, and various hills and rockfaces stood out across the path. Various village houses and even a burial house could be found towards the side of the map, with the path terminating at a large communal structure. ==Interactive Map== {{Tabber |Stage 1 |{{Map:The Haunted PastS1}} |Stage 2 |{{Map:The Haunted PastS2}} }} ==Story== ''For more information, see [[The Haunted Past/Story]].'' Unlike [[A Dark Tale]], '''The Haunted Past''' did not have much of a story. There was only one cutscene in the act, which played after Wave 9. In there, [[The Umbra]] makes three enemies, the [[Mummy (Lunar Overture)|Mummy]], [[Demon (Lunar Overture)|Demon]] and [[Scarecrow (Lunar Overture)|Scarecrow]] go collect a [[God Cube]] fragment. When [[Jack-o-Bot]] is destroyed at the end of the match, the [[Narrator (Narrator)|Narrator]] says that [[The Umbra]] had been the one who sent [[Jack O' Bot]] to fight the player in [[Nightmare Carnival]] all those years ago. ==Rewards== The game calculated how many {{Coins|Coins}} and {{Exp|}} you receive based on how many waves were survived and if the match was won. During periods of 50% more {{Exp|}} (08:00 UTC Friday – 08:00 UTC Sunday), any {{Exp|}} earned was multiplied by 1.5x. The VIP [[Gamepasses|gamepass]] also multiplies any {{Exp|}} earned by 1.25x. Any reward that ends in a decimal point is rounded down, no matter the first figure of the leading decimal. Rewards were calculated as: {| class="tds-table pad-10" style="text-align: center; margin:1em auto" !Coins Reward !EXP Reward |- |({{Coins|500}} ÷ (1 + [(20 ÷ Current Wave) - 1]^1.3) + {{Coins|100}} (Triumph Only)) × 1.2 |({{Exp|80}} ÷ (1 + [(20 ÷ Current Wave) - 1])) × 1.2 |} It was possible to randomly get these accessories upon triumph of the second act: {| class="light-table pad-5" style="width:300px; text-align:center; margin:0 auto" ! |[[File:JackoBotHead.png|175px|link=]] |[[File:JackoBotChestplate.png|175px|link=]] |[[File:ReaperGear.png|175px|link=]] |- ! |{{RLinkC|15169364528|Jack O' Bot Head}} |{{RLinkC|15169347067|Jack O' Bot Chestplate}} |{{RLinkC|15169275236|Reaper's Gear}} |- !Stock |30,000 |15,000 |3,000 |} ==Wave Structure== The formula for calculating wave bonus on each wave was: :({{Money|500}} + (Waves Completed - 1) × {{Money|150}}) × (1 - 0.1 × Players) The wave clear bonus appeared when no damage was dealt to the base. In solos, it is one fourth of the wave bonus. In duo or higher, it is one fifth of the wave bonus. The waves in '''The Haunted Past''' could not be skipped, though the cutscenes could be. They followed these timings: {| class="wikitable pad-10 align-center" style="margin:0 auto; width:50%" !Waves !Wave Timer |- |1-8 |1:00 |- |9 |∞ |- |10 |2:00 |- |11 |∞ |- |12-14 |2:00 |- |15 |∞ |- |16-17 |2:00 |- |18 |∞ |- |19 |2:00 |- |20 |∞ |} '''Bolded''' names indicate an enemy type's debut. ----

==Strategy== *Early game towers with flying detection, like the [[Golden Soldier]] or [[Ace Pilot]] are highly recommended to deal both with the regular enemies and the [[Witch (Lunar Overture)|Witches]] that spawn. **Later on, the [[Ranger]] and [[Pursuit]] can also work well against them. *Area of effect towers, like the [[Golden Pyromancer]] and [[Mortar]] are recommended due to the large number of enemies that spawn. *The [[Golden Scout]] is not effective due to its lack of DPS. *High DPS towers, such as the [[Ranger]], [[Accelerator]] and [[Golden Minigunner]] are needed later on due to enemies like the [[Frankenstein (Lunar Overture)|Frankenstein]] having high amounts of health, especially with the [[Mutation]] modifier. *Towers such as [[Sledger]] and [[Electroshocker]] can be useful at stalling the large amounts of enemies during the second part of this map. *The [[Farm]] should not be brought as it does not generate any cash. **The [[Cowboy]] and [[Golden Cowboy]] also get their income reduced in this map, so it is not recommended to bring these towers. *The [[DJ Booth]] and [[Commander]] are highly recommended to support your towers. *After the first cutscene, all your towers are sold, so make sure you quickly place them back when Wave 10 starts. ==Trivia== *This map is based on two previous Halloween event maps, with the first phase being based on the [[Nightmare Carnival]] from [[Halloween 2019 Event]] and the second phase being based on the [[Trick or Threat Town]] from the [[Halloween 2020 Event]]. **The events shown in '''The Haunted Past''' appear to be a retelling of both the [[Halloween 2019 Event]] and [[Halloween 2020 Event]], with the main focus being the [[Halloween 2019 Event]], with the [[Narrator (Narrator)|Narrator]]'s comment after beating [[Jack-o-Bot]] hinting at this heavily. **'''The Haunted Past''' has the same amount of waves as the [[Nightmare Carnival]]. **The [[Narrator (Narrator)|Narrator]]'s first Wave 20 voice line saying "''Oh, it's 5:30. Right on schedule!''" is a reference to the first wave line of dialogue in the [[Halloween 2019 Event]] saying "''*The clock strikes 5:30 PM*''" *There are multiple audios which were meant to, at one point, play on this map.
